title: Design a Real-Time Chat, Typing & Presence System (Slack / Discord / WhatsApp Scale)
prompt: Design a real-time chat and presence platform supporting 50M concurrent WebSocket connections, 1M messages/sec, < 100 ms p99 message delivery, multi-device read-cursor sync, and both 1:1 DMs and 100K-member channels.

spark.summary: Terminate stateful WebSockets at edge Gateway Pods backed by Redis session maps, sequence messages per channel with Snowflake/monotonic IDs into ScyllaDB/Cassandra, and route offline users to APNs/FCM.
spark.keyTakeaway: To keep the architecture evolvable without sacrificing reliability, typing & Presence System (Slack /, partition message tables by `(channel_id, bucket_month)` with clustering key `message_id` (Snowflake) to keep history scans O(1) seek and prevent unbounded partition growth.
spark.byteSummary:
At 50M concurrent WebSocket connections (~1,000 Gateway Pods holding 50K connections each), statefulness lives strictly at the edge gateway layer while all routing and persistence remain horizontally scalable.

Each incoming message receives a time-ordered **Snowflake ID** (or per-channel sequence ID) so clients sort messages deterministically across devices without relying on client clocks. Messages persist asynchronously to **ScyllaDB / Cassandra** partitioned by `(channel_id, time_bucket)` to bound partition sizes.

Online recipients receive instant push via Redis Pub/Sub -> target Gateway Pod; offline recipients fall back to an APNs/FCM Push Queue, while a separate `read_cursors` table syncs unread badges across mobile and desktop.

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Design a Real-Time Chat, Typing & Presence System (Slack / Discord / WhatsApp Scale) without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: To keep the architecture evolvable without sacrificing reliability, typing & Presence System (Slack /, partition message tables by `(channel_id, bucket_month)` with clustering key `message_id` (Snowflake) to keep history scans O(1) seek and prevent unbounded partition growth.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

prerequisites.title: Real-Time Presence, Heartbeat Hysteresis & Hybrid Fan-Out
prerequisites.summary: Real-time presence uses periodic WebSocket heartbeats into TTL-backed Redis keys (`SETEX 45s`) with online/offline hysteresis, paired with hybrid push/pull fan-out for small vs. massive channels.

prerequisites.title: Consistent Hashing & Virtual Nodes
prerequisites.summary: Consistent hashing assigns data keys to servers in a way that limits how many keys move when servers are added or removed. This helps avoid widespread cache misses and sudden load on databases.
